'''David Burnham Tanner''' is a Distinguished Professor of Physics<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://fora.aa.ufl.edu/provost/IndependentFora/Distinguished-Professors |title=Distinguished Professors |publisher=ufl.edu |accessdate=May 14, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.phys.ufl.edu/faculty/tanner.shtml |title=David Tanner |publisher=ufl.edu |accessdate=May 14, 2017}}</ref> and an affiliate professor in the Department of Chemistry at the [[University of Florida]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.chem.ufl.edu/people/name/david-tanner/ |title=Department of Chemistry, People |publisher=chem.ufl.edu |date= |accessdate= }}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

He studied at the [[University of Virginia]] where he received his [[Bachelor of Arts|B. A.]] degree. He has a [[Doctorate|PhD in Physics]] from [[Cornell University]].<ref>
{{cite thesis |type=PhD |publisher=[[Cornell University]] |publication-place= |last=Tanner |first=David |date=1972-08-01 |title=Some size effects in metals in the far infrared |oclc=743364351 |osti=4569168 |hdl= |doi=10.2172/4569168 |doi-access=free }}
</ref>

He was elected a [[Fellow of the American Physical Society]] in 1989 ''"for studies of the basic infrared properties of new materials"''.<ref> {{cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=&year=1989&unit_id=&institution=|title=APS Fwellow Archive|publisher=APS|accessdate= 5 October 2020}} </ref> and awarded their [[Frank Isakson Prize for Optical Effects in Solids]] in 2016.<ref> {{cite web|url=https://www.phys.ufl.edu/wp/|title=Welcome to the Physics Department at the University of Florida|publisher=UF|accessdate= 5 October 2020}} </ref>

He published the textbook ''Optical Effects in Solids'' in 2019.<ref>
{{cite book |last=Tanner |first=David |date=April 2019 |title=Optical Effects in Solids |edition= |url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/books/optical-effects-in-solids/301E17684CBC18373E72647CD0636BB4 |location= |publisher=[[Cambridge University Press]] |isbn=9781316672778}}
</ref>
